failure.symptom: TorchInductor could not execute Triton's bundled ptxas after the verified runtime transfer removed executable mode bits.
failure.evidence: All eight workers failed their first compiled policy query with the same ptxas PermissionError and produced zero valid episodes.

repair.scope: Verify the transferred Triton tool bytes, restore mode 0755 on all four bundled NVIDIA tools, execute each version preflight, and reset only the two zero-episode failed result trees.

invariants: Only executable mode bits on byte-verified staged runtime tools are changed.
Checkpoint bytes, policy code, Python packages, and compile settings are unchanged.
Tasks, evaluation seeds, scene seeds, episodes per cell, replan horizon, instruction type, and action bridge are unchanged.
The stopped attempts contribute no policy-effect evidence because they produced zero valid episodes.
Each retry requires a fresh resource recommendation audit before platform submission.
